tests.description: A source not matching the authenticated principal is rejected (I9, SPEC §8.4).
tests.scenario: The connection authenticates as principal rpa_001. A message arrives with source: "rpa_007". The harness MUST reject it (auth failure), never process it, and log the rejection to audit.

tests.description: Messages on an expired session are answered with SESSION_EXPIRED (SPEC §4.6).
tests.scenario: A message arrives for a session whose TTL has passed and that has not been resumed. The harness MUST reply with an error message carrying code SESSION_EXPIRED and must not execute anything.

tests.description: Credential-like content in ordinary payloads is rejected (I10, SPEC §8.1).
tests.scenario: Send an event whose data contains patterns such as "Bearer <token>", "password=...", "Authorization: ...", or an api_key field. The harness MUST NOT forward such payloads to the decision engine; it rejects the message and logs a security event. (Bootstrap credentials via the application-level secure mechanism are the only exception.)

tests.description: A policy violation yields a terminal rejected result, never execution (SPEC §8.3, §9.4).
tests.scenario: Policy max_risk = L2 and require_approval = ["erp.order.approve"]. The decision engine sends erp.order.approve without approval. The gateway MUST respond with a terminal result status=rejected and MUST NOT forward to the executor.

tests.description: Timestamps must never establish ordering (I8, SPEC §5.5).
tests.scenario: Send two events on the same stream where the second has an EARLIER ts than the first but a HIGHER seq. The harness MUST apply them in seq order. A harness that reorders by ts fails conformance.
